about_the_game:
Adrian, an elven merchant, has spent years traveling across the land, trading goods to survive. When whispers of war reach his ears, he makes a bold investment—buying up metal to sell for a profit in a distant border city.

But fate has other plans.

While resting on the road, Adrian is ambushed by two orc girls from rival clans: Bertha, a fierce green-skinned warrior, and Helen, a fiery red orc with her own motives. He wakes up in a hidden orc camp deep in the forest, locked in a cage… and chosen for a ritual he never expected.

Turns out, this settlement is home to only orc women. And the ritual? It’s about securing the future of their people—through him.

Adrian must adapt to orc culture, survive their "training," and figure out how to escape... or maybe embrace his role.

🔥 FEATURES

💬 Choice-driven visual novel with multiple outcomes

💪 Short Visual Novel with tomboys.

🌿 One elf. Two orcs. Countless possibilities.
